name: Back in stock alerts
description: Shoppers leave their email on out-of-stock products and are emailed when the product is back.

name: Bulk price editor
description: Raise, lower, round or put on sale the prices of many products at once, with a preview before you apply and a one-click undo.

name: Buy again
description: Lets customers reorder in one click from their past orders and from a Buy again page listing everything they have bought before.

name: Cart discount rules
description: Automatic discounts: bulk quantity discounts, buy X get Y and spend tiers, with dates and role conditions.

name: Checkout fields Pro
description: Conditional checkout fields, priced fields that add a fee, date, radio, multi-checkbox and heading fields, fields per customer role, and checkout field values in the orders list and a CSV export.

name: Conditional shipping
description: Show or hide shipping methods by cart contents, subtotal, weight, customer role and destination postcode.

name: Customer pricing
description: Gives individual customers their own prices: fixed prices or percentage discounts per product, and an account-wide discount.

name: Delivery date
description: Let customers choose a delivery or pickup date, and optionally a time slot, at checkout, based on your lead time, cutoff time and open days.

name: Free shipping bar
description: Shows how much more the customer needs to spend to get free shipping, on the cart, checkout and mini cart.

name: Gift cards
description: Sell gift cards that are emailed to the recipient and redeemed with the normal coupon field.

name: Order approval
description: Customers in chosen roles, or orders over a set amount, submit orders for approval before they pay.

name: Order rules
description: Minimum, maximum and pack-size quantities per product, plus minimum and maximum order values and quantities for the cart.

name: Pay by invoice
description: Lets approved business customers order now and pay later by invoice, with net payment terms and optional credit limits.

name: PDF invoices Pro
description: PDF invoices in Greek, Cyrillic, Arabic, Hebrew and every Latin-script language, three templates, credit notes, proforma invoices, bulk downloads and invoice number formats.

name: Points and rewards
description: Customers earn points on every order and spend them as a discount at checkout.

name: Pre-orders
description: Take orders for products before they are released, with a release date, pre-order price and an email to customers when the product ships.

name: Private store
description: Make the whole store, the shop pages or chosen categories visible to logged-in customers only.

name: Product add-ons
description: Add extra paid or free options to products, such as gift wrap, engraving text or a choice of colour, per product or for whole categories.

name: Product enquiry
description: Adds an Ask a question form to product pages that emails the store and keeps every enquiry in wp-admin.

name: Product file upload
description: Lets customers upload files with a product, such as artwork for printing, stored privately and linked from the order.

name: Purchase limits
description: Limit how many of a product each customer can buy, per order, per period or once only.

name: Purchase order number
description: Collect a purchase order (PO) number at checkout and show it on the order, in emails, in My Account and in the orders list.

name: Quick order form
description: A bulk order form listing products and variations with quantities, so customers add many items to the cart at once.

name: Quote Pro
description: Adds expiry dates, reminder emails, automatic cancellation and a My Account Quotes page where customers accept or decline quotes.

name: Role visibility
description: Hide products and categories from chosen roles and guests, everywhere products are listed or sold.

name: Role-based checkout
description: Choose which payment and shipping methods each customer role can use at checkout.

name: Sample orders
description: Lets customers order a sample of chosen products at a fixed sample price or free, with per-order limits.

name: Store credit
description: Gives customers a store credit balance that admins can top up, refunds can be paid into, and customers can spend at checkout.

name: Tax exempt & VAT numbers
description: Exempt chosen roles from tax and collect EU VAT numbers at checkout, with reverse charge for valid EU businesses.

name: Tiered pricing
description: Quantity break prices per product, variation, category and role, applied in the cart and shown as a price table.

name: Variation swatches Pro
description: Swatches on shop pages and product blocks that switch the image and add the chosen variation to the cart, plus per-product swatch overrides, image tooltips and a radio-list style.

name: Wholesale registration
description: A wholesale application form with admin approval that turns approved applicants into wholesale customers.

name: Wholesale tiers
description: Multiple wholesale levels, each with its own role, store-wide discount and category discounts.

name: Wishlist Pro
description: Multiple named wishlists, add all to cart, price-drop and back-in-stock emails, a most-wishlisted report and social proof for the Wishlist kit.
